title: Google Summer of Code
eligibility: Students and beginners to open source, 18+
summary: A global program (applications typically open Feb-Mar) offering stipends to contribute to open source projects under an experienced mentor's guidance.

title: Outreachy Internship
eligibility: Open to people from groups underrepresented in tech; two rounds per year (May & Dec cohorts)
summary: Paid, remote open-source internships with a strong focus on diversity, running twice yearly.

title: MLH Fellowship
eligibility: University students and early-career developers
summary: A 12-week remote fellowship where participants work in small pods contributing to real open-source codebases.

title: Devpost Hackathons (Rolling)
eligibility: Open to all skill levels; varies by event
summary: The largest hub of ongoing hackathons across every domain. A good way to build portfolio projects and meet recruiters.

title: MLH Hackathons (Rolling)
eligibility: Primarily students, some open to all
summary: The official student hackathon league, running weekend events year-round in-person and online.

title: Unstop Hackathons & Competitions
eligibility: Students and early professionals in India and globally
summary: India's largest platform aggregating hackathons, case competitions, and off-campus job/internship drives.

title: LinkedIn Jobs: Entry Level Tech Roles
eligibility: Open to all experience levels; filter by entry-level
summary: The largest professional job board. Use skill and location filters to find roles matching your resume.

title: Wellfound (AngelList) Startup Jobs
eligibility: Open to all
summary: A job board focused on startup roles, often with faster hiring cycles and equity compensation.

title: Google Careers: University & Entry-Level
eligibility: Students and recent graduates
summary: Google's official careers page listing university internships and entry-level software engineering roles.

title: Microsoft Careers: Students & Grads
eligibility: Students and recent graduates
summary: Microsoft's early-in-career hub for internships and full-time roles across engineering, PM, and design.

title: Amazon Student Programs
eligibility: Students and recent graduates
summary: Amazon's internship and new-grad program listings for SDE, data science, and operations roles.

title: Gates Cambridge Scholarship
eligibility: Outstanding non-UK graduate applicants (annual cycle, deadlines vary by country)
summary: A full-cost postgraduate scholarship at Cambridge for outstanding applicants from outside the UK.

title: Fulbright Foreign Student Program
eligibility: International graduate students and young professionals
summary: A prestigious international exchange program funding graduate study and research in the United States.

title: ADPList Mentorship
eligibility: Open to all career stages
summary: A free platform connecting mentees with industry mentors across product, design, and engineering.

title: Kaggle Competitions
eligibility: Open to all skill levels
summary: Ongoing data science and machine learning competitions, great for building a public ML portfolio.

title: IEEE Student Conferences
eligibility: Students and researchers submitting papers or attending
summary: IEEE hosts hundreds of student-friendly technical conferences yearly across every engineering discipline.

title: SheCodes / Women Who Code Programs
eligibility: Women and non-binary individuals in tech
summary: A global community offering scholarships, mentorship, and networking events for women in technology.

title: LFX Mentorship
eligibility: Students and early-career developers interested in open source infrastructure
summary: Paid mentorship program contributing to Linux Foundation projects like Kubernetes, CNCF, and Hyperledger.

title: Path Forward Returnship Matcher
eligibility: People returning to paid work after a caregiving break. Free for returners.
summary: A US nonprofit whose Returnship Matcher lists returnship programmes from partner companies, updated weekly. Signing up is not applying: you apply through each company's own site.

title: Intuit Again Returnship
eligibility: People returning to the workforce after a career break, especially technologists returning after caregiving. Check the official page for current terms.
summary: A structured, paid returnship designed to lead to full-time roles, with a dedicated programme team and fellow returnees. Intuit describes it as a 16-week programme on its careers site.

title: Accenture Career Reboot Program (India)
eligibility: Professionals with a career break of over 24 months, per Accenture's FAQ. Check the official page for current terms.
summary: A paid return-to-work programme with tailored learning paths, mentorship and a supportive community. Accenture lets you choose a track based on your skills and experience.

title: HerKey (formerly JobsForHer)
eligibility: Women at any career stage, including those restarting after a break.
summary: A career platform for women in India that began as a way to return to work after a break and now offers jobs, learning and communities across the career lifecycle.

title: Google Career Certificates
eligibility: No degree or prior experience required, per Grow with Google.
summary: Self-paced online certificates in fields such as data analytics, UX design, project management and IT support, built to be job-ready in roughly 3 to 6 months of part-time study. Check the official page for the current course list.

title: CTET: Central Teacher Eligibility Test (India)
eligibility: Determines eligibility to be appointed as a teacher for Classes 1 to 8. Always check the official site for eligibility and dates.
summary: The national eligibility test for teaching Classes 1 to 8, conducted by CBSE for the Ministry of Education. Notices, eligibility and dates change, so confirm everything on the official site.
